inspection.scope: Full microscopic SU(4) hypercolor regime of Section 2, weakly coupled to the source SM gauge fields and elementary SM fermions; before confinement. No independent elementary Higgs or IR composite partner is added.

claims.locator: PDF p.5 Table 1 and caption; p.6 Section 2.1
claims.fact: All Table 1 fields are two-component LH fermions: psi in antisymmetric6 of SU4HC and flavour5; chi in4HC,flavour3,X=-1/3; chi_tilde inbar4HC,flavourbar3,X=+1/3. Colour is the diagonal of the two flavour SU3 factors. The global SU5,U1X,U1prime are not additional independently gauged factors.

claims.locator: PDF p.10 Section 3.1, Eq. (11) matrices and Y=T_R3+X paragraph
claims.fact: The source EW embedding restricts the flavour5 to (2,2)+(1,1) under SU2L×SU2R, hence one LH HC6 weak doublet with Y=+1/2, one with Y=-1/2, and one HC6 weak singlet Y=0. This is the complete five-flavour psi inventory, not five copies of each weak representation. Chi and chi_tilde are weak singlets, with Y=X.

claims.locator: PDF p.4 Section 2 defines GSM; p.16 Section 3.3 states i=1,2,3 family number; p.17 Eq. (30) and following lepton paragraph
claims.fact: The theory includes elementary ordinary SM quarks and leptons, all hypercolor singlets. Expand the declared F_SM baseline of three Q,u^c,d^c,L,e^c families. The Higgs is composite, not an elementary SM scalar in this microscopic regime. Spurionic embeddings and auxiliary entries in Eq. (30) do not create new independent particles or RH-neutrino containers.

claims.locator: PDF pp.5-6 Tables 1-2 and Eq. (1); p.10 Eq. (10)
claims.fact: Only Table 1 hyperfermions plus elementary SM fermions are independent microscopic matter. Composite bosons/fermionic operators, pNGB coordinates, and auxiliary NJL fields are not appended. A higher-energy origin for four-fermi interactions is not supplied, but its absence is not a gate on this stated inventory.

claims.locator: PDF pp.5,10 source charges and Atlas conventions
claims.fact: Use exact A3 labels6=[0,1,0],4=[1,0,0],bar4=[0,0,1]. All fermions already LH. Over complete inventory q=6Y is primitive: psi doublets±3,chi=-2,chi_tilde=+2; inherited Q has charge1.

limitations: Gauge-matter inventory of the source microscopic model below the unspecified four-fermi-generating physics; no phenomenological viability or UV-origin certification.
No elementary Higgs exists in this regime; the SM Higgs arises as a composite. Three SM generations use the explicit source family count and the declared F_SM convention.
